missing_methods.intent: Get user profile name from dashboard header
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Locate the user profile name element in the dashboard header, wait for it to be visible, extract and return the text content of the profile name.

Locate the user profile name element in the dashboard header, wait for it to be visible, retrieve the displayed text, and assert that it matches the expected_name parameter. Should raise an assertion error if the names do not match or if the element is not displayed.
